content.short: Merchant Moe is the native cornerstone DEX of Mantle Network, built on Liquidity Book technology for capital-efficient trading and real yield.
content.description: Merchant Moe is the purpose-built decentralized exchange for Mantle Network, leveraging the Liquidity Book (LB) algorithm  the same technology behind LFJ Dex  to offer discretized liquidity bins for superior capital efficiency over traditional AMMs. Backed by an investment from the Mantle EcoFund and a deep liquidity partnership with the Mantle Foundation, Merchant Moe provides two AMM types: Moe Classic (constant product) and Moe Liquidity Book (discrete bins). The protocol's native MOE token powers a veMOE governance and gauge voting system where stakers direct farm emissions to liquidity pools. Liquidity providers earn 0.25% on all trades plus additional farming rewards, with zero price impact possible on stable asset pairs.
